name: jira-source
description: Pull tasks from Jira issues, write results back

configSchema.label: Jira URL
configSchema.help: The site's address, e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net or https://jira.example.com

configSchema.label: Account email
configSchema.help: Jira Cloud: the email of the account the API token belongs to. Leave blank for Jira Data Center / Server, where the token is a personal access token. Test connection checks which kind the site is

configSchema.label: API token
configSchema.help: A Jira Cloud API token or a Data Center personal access token, or {"$env":"WORCA_JIRA_TOKEN"} (WORCA_JIRA_TOKEN_<NAME> for each further site)

configSchema.label: Transition on completion
configSchema.help: Optional. A transition or status name (e.g. Done) to move the issue to when a run that writes back finishes successfully. Blank = comment only
